[SWS_SM_00705] Request OS to enter suspend state
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00402
⌈
To enter the OS suspend state,
ara::sm::s2r::S2RHub::EnterSuspend-
ToRamOs
shall forward the call to
apext::sm::PowerStateInterface::Set-
PowerState
with
state
set to
kPmSuspendToRam
.
